keybind.invalid: "{key}" is not a key Keyboard understands. Write it as SUPER + Space.
keybind.invalid_title: Keyboard: the key binding is not valid
keybind.taken: {key} is already bound, so Keyboard left it alone. Pick another key in its settings.

panel.managed: Keyboard keeps these layouts and sets them in Hyprland while Noctalia runs; your Hyprland config is not changed.
panel.no_more_ims: fcitx5 has no other input methods. Install one, such as fcitx5-mozc for Japanese or fcitx5-chinese-addons for Chinese.
panel.none: No keyboard layouts or input methods found. Keyboard reads Hyprland's layouts and fcitx5's input methods.
panel.title: Keyboard
